content: पारुष्यम् [परुषस्य भावः ष्यञ्] .²1 Roughness, ruggedness, hardness. .²2 Harshness, cruelty, unkindness (as of disposition). .²3 Abusive language, abuse, reproach, scurrilous language, insult; <ls>Bg. 16. 4</ls>; <ls>Y. 2. 12</ls>, <ls n="Y. 2.">72</ls>; हिंसा तदभिमानेन दण्ड्यपारुष्ययोर्यथा . वैषम्यमिह भूतानां ममाहमिति पार्थिव .. <ls>Bhāg. 7. 1. 23</ls>. .²4 Violence (in word or deed); <ls>Ms. 7. 48</ls>, <ls n="Ms. 7.">51</ls>, <ls n="Ms.">8. 6</ls>, <ls n="Ms. 8.">72</ls>. .²5 The garden of Indra. .²6 Aloe-wood. .{@-ष्यः@} An epithet of Bṛhaspati.
